heading: About
paragraphs: C++ and Linux as the foundation, IoT and embedded systems as the direction.

C++ remains my strongest language, notably through a game engine written with my team on R-Type. Linux, the command line, Git and Docker round out that foundation. Backend experience adds to it: backend tech lead on Melo, my end-of-studies project.

A year in South Korea, using English every day: very comfortable speaking and reading, solid in writing. Seeking a six-month end-of-studies internship from March 2027, with a view to a permanent position.
